scheme_name: Rajasthan Chief Minister's Relief Fund - Kargil Package
description:
The Rajasthan Chief Minister's Relief Fund - Kargil Package was launched in 1999. 

This initiative was established in response to the Kargil War that took place between May and July 1999. 

The war was fought between India and Pakistan in the Kargil district of Jammu and Kashmir. 

It involved the infiltration of Pakistani soldiers and militants into Indian territory. 

The conflict resulted in significant loss of life and injuries to many soldiers. 

In recognition of the sacrifices made by the armed forces, the Rajasthan government initiated this relief package. 

The primary objective of the Kargil Package is to provide financial assistance to the families of martyrs. 

It aims to support the families of soldiers who lost their lives during the Kargil conflict. 

The scheme also seeks to assist those who were injured during the war. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is intended to alleviate the hardships faced by these families. 

The Kargil Package includes a one-time financial grant of INR 5 lakh. 

This amount is given to the families of each martyr from Rajasthan. 

Additionally, soldiers who were injured in the Kargil War are eligible for financial assistance. 

Injured soldiers can receive a one-time grant of INR 2 lakh. 

The scheme also includes provisions for educational support. 

Children of martyrs are provided with scholarships to encourage their education. 

The scholarship amount varies based on the level of education. 

For students pursuing higher education, the scholarship can go up to INR 20,000 per year. 

This financial support is aimed at ensuring that the children of martyrs can continue their studies without financial burden. 

The eligibility criteria for the Kargil Package are specific. 

Only families of soldiers who were martyred during the Kargil War are eligible for the relief fund. 

The soldier must have been a resident of Rajasthan at the time of their death. 

Injured soldiers from Rajasthan who served in the Kargil War are also eligible for assistance. 

The application process for the Kargil Package is straightforward. 

Eligible families must submit an application to the District Collector's office. 

The application must include specific documents for verification. 

Required documents include the death certificate of the soldier. 

Families must also provide proof of residence in Rajasthan. 

Additionally, a copy of the soldier's service record is necessary. 

The application must be accompanied by an affidavit stating the details of the soldier's service. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the District Collector. 

The Collector verifies the details and forwards the application for approval. 

The disbursement of funds is typically processed within 30 days of approval. 

The Kargil Package is administered by the Department of Home Affairs of Rajasthan. 

The Chief Minister's office oversees the implementation of this relief fund. 

For any inquiries or assistance, families can contact the Department of Home Affairs. 

The contact details are available on the official Rajasthan government website. 

The Kargil Package is part of a broader initiative to support armed forces personnel and their families. 

The Rajasthan government has consistently recognized the sacrifices made by soldiers. 

The Kargil Package reflects the state’s commitment to the welfare of military personnel. 

The scheme has been well-received by the families of martyrs. 

It has provided much-needed financial support during difficult times. 

The Rajasthan government has also organized various events to honor the martyrs. 

These events serve to raise awareness about the sacrifices made by soldiers. 

The Kargil Package is a testament to the state's dedication to its armed forces. 

The financial assistance provided has made a significant impact on the lives of many families. 

The scheme continues to be relevant as new generations of soldiers serve the nation. 

The Kargil Package is reviewed periodically to ensure its effectiveness. 

The government remains committed to making necessary adjustments based on feedback. 

This ensures that the assistance provided meets the evolving needs of the families. 

The Kargil Package is part of a larger framework of welfare schemes for veterans. 

These schemes aim to provide a safety net for those who have served the country. 

The Rajasthan Chief Minister's Relief Fund is crucial in this regard. 

It demonstrates the importance of supporting the families of those who have made the ultimate sacrifice. 

The Kargil Package stands as a symbol of gratitude from the state to its soldiers. 

It reinforces the bond between the government and the armed forces. 

The scheme is a vital resource for families navigating the aftermath of loss. 

It ensures that the legacy of the martyrs is honored through tangible support. 

The Kargil Package is a significant aspect of Rajasthan's welfare initiatives. 

It highlights the state's proactive approach to veteran affairs. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is crucial for the well-being of affected families. 

The Rajasthan government continues to explore additional measures to support its soldiers. 

The Kargil Package remains a cornerstone of these efforts. 

It reflects the state's ongoing commitment to the welfare of its armed forces personnel and their families. 

Overall, the Rajasthan Chief Minister's Relief Fund - Kargil Package is a comprehensive initiative. 

It provides essential financial support and educational assistance to families of martyrs and injured soldiers. 

The scheme is a vital part of Rajasthan's commitment to honoring its heroes.
